kurz: Time changes everything: connective tissue dissolves, dough develops flavour, salt soaks in, protein firms up.
bild_im_kopf: The invisible ingredient that is in every recipe.
was_passiert: Some processes need time rather than heat: connective tissue, [[fermentation|fermentation]], salting, spreading aromas. In others time is the enemy: protein turns dry, green turns grey, foam collapses.
faustregeln: Tough meat, bread dough, marinades: more time.
Fish, green vegetables, eggs: less time.
